description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Cast Wrenn and Realmbreaker by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Wrenn and Realmbreaker's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing a land you control to become a 3/3 Elemental in addition to its other types.
Activate Wrenn and Realmbreaker's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Wrenn and Realmbreaker dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Wrenn and Realmbreaker ability, causing you to get an emblem.
 Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 7.
